description: This file defines a React component named 'Home' using the Lightning.js framework. It manages state related to notes, interacts with a store for data persistence, and composes several subcomponents such as NotesList, EditorPanel, EmptyState, and TopNav to form the main page layout.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Lightning.js Component representing the main page layout of the note-taking application, managing notes state, subscribing to store updates, and displaying subcomponents.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is mounted; loads data from storage and subscribes to store updates.

methods.name: destroyed
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is destroyed; unsubscribes from store updates.

methods.name: _sync
methods.description: Custom method to update the notes count from the store’s state.
